pull.title: wallet: don't announce resubmitted transactions under -privatebroadcast
pull.body:
This doesn't fix the general case of rebroadcasting potentially surprising users by divulging the originator IP trivially, but for users opting into private broadcast, it seems a bridge too far for them to expect the current behavior.

e.g. an incoming dust payment triggering your node to rebroadcast 24-36th later over clearnet

This can be removed if/when wallet drives through private broadcast.

see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/3828 for running broader issue

> but for users opting into private broadcast, it seems a bridge too far for them to expect the current behavior.

Is it? The current behavior is that all transactions being sent via the wallet do not use private broadcast at all; `CommitTransaction` uses `MEMPOOL_AND_BROADCAST_TO_ALL`, and it follows that resubmit behaves in the same way.

See also: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34533#issuecomment-3969991481

> The current behavior is that all transactions being sent via the wallet do not use private broadcast at all

This is true, but the case this change is protecting against is transactions sent by other means that also belong to the wallet.

So if a user is running with `-privatebroadcast` and is sending transactions via `sendrawtransaction`, if they have a watch only wallet or their addresses are dusted with low fee transactions, then the wallet will still rebroadcast these transactions. This could be unexpected if the user thinks they are protected by `-privatebroadcast`.

comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -1953,9 +1947,16 @@ void CWallet::ResubmitWalletTransactions(node::TxBroadcast broadcast_method, boo
 
 void MaybeResendWalletTxs(WalletContext& context)
 {
+    // With -privatebroadcast, a transaction may have left through a private broadcast and come
+    // back from the network. Announcing it again from this node's own connections, long after
+    // every other node went quiet about it, would mark it as this node's: keep it in the mempool
+    // without announcing it.
+    const auto broadcast_method{context.args->GetBoolArg("-privatebroadcast", DEFAULT_PRIVATE_BROADCAST)
+                                    ? node::TxBroadcast::MEMPOOL_NO_BROADCAST
+                                    : node::TxBroadcast::MEMPOOL_AND_BROADCAST_TO_ALL};
